---
pagetitle: "Ameya Panchal"
page-layout: full
toc: false
include-in-header:
  - text: |
      <link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/home/home.css">
listing:
  - id: writing
    contents: posts
    type: default
    sort: "date desc"
    fields: [title, description, date, reading-time]
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    feed: true
  # The rough tier: one-line rows (title + date), no descriptions. Notes are
  # comment-sized — paper reactions, small results, dead ends. Deliberately NOT
  # branded a "second brain": a folder that accumulates when something is worth
  # writing never looks stale; a system that promises upkeep does.
  - id: notes
    contents: notes
    type: default
    sort: "date desc"
    fields: [title, date]
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
---

     change what the page says, or what is on it, edit the inventory — a new

     for a section that IS the page (everything dimmed to nothing, and the
     transform made the fixed foot scroll away). The three home-page rules that
     styles.scss keys on body:has(.hero-screen) are restated in home.css. -->
